title: AIP-eligible paved runways in fair-or-better condition reach 97.3 percent
summary: DOT reports 97.3 percent of Airport Improvement Program-eligible paved runways in fair or better condition in FY 2025, above the 93 percent target. Denominator: Airport Improvement Program-eligible paved runways evaluated under FAA's runway-condition measure.
key_findings: Finding: DOT reports 97.3 percent of Airport Improvement Program-eligible paved runways in fair or better condition in FY 2025, above the 93 percent target.
